raw_artifact_policy: Raw CompletionSet JSON, ScoreReport JSON, databases, adapters, and local reproduction scripts are not part of the tracked public bundle.
public_mode: make eval validates this tracked summary and renders the README headline table without model, GPU, network, database, or raw completion artifacts.
full_artifact_mode: Restored raw artifacts are re-scored by make eval-full; full training reruns are outside the public quickstart.
source_volume: not exposed in the public bundle
notes: GRPO headline uses three seed-level runs; confidence intervals are computed over per-seed execution accuracy.
results/public/claims.json maps public README claims to committed evidence.
The public bundle is a compact evidence index, not a full training reproduction package.
